title: Prestige Group — Risk & Reputation Research
content:
Customer complaints about Prestige Group primarily revolve around construction quality and maintenance issues, with reviews highlighting seepage problems, water leakage, poor finishing quality, lift-related concerns, and inconsistent upkeep of common areas. Reviews on Mouthshut mention a lack of cooperation from the CRM and issues with possession processes. In contrast, reviews on Trustpilot for Prestige Telecom Group are mixed, with some praising customer service while others report false advertising and unsolicited calls. Yelp reviews for Prestige Medical Group focus on payment options and unprofessional treatment from staff, leading to lost patients and negative experiences.

According to reviews on Mouthshut, Prestige Group Real Estate faces criticism for value for money, with buyers paying premium prices for aging infrastructure and dated layouts. There are also recurring concerns about maintenance and construction quality, including seepage issues, water leakage, poor finishing quality, and inconsistent upkeep of common areas. However, The Silicon Review and a YouTube video highlight Prestige Group's efforts to build trust and stability in the real estate market, emphasizing their achievements in creating sought-after addresses and their financial credibility. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on the extent of Prestige Group's reputation problems.

The biggest issue is value for money. Buyers are being asked to pay premium prices for apartments in a project that is more than a decade old. At current resale valuations, purchasers are effectively paying luxury-project rates for aging infrastructure, dated layouts, and buildings that no longer compete with newer developments in the same price bracket. The Prestige brand and township reputation appear to be contributing more to the pricing than the actual quality of the asset itself. [...] A recurring concern among residents and reviewers has been maintenance and construction quality. Multiple reviews mention seepage issues, water leakage, poor finishing quality in some units, lift-related concerns, and inconsistent upkeep of common areas. For a project commanding premium prices, buyers should reasonably expect superior construction standards and lower maintenance headaches. [...] In conclusion, Prestige Shantiniketan remains a recognizable address, but recognition alone does not justify its current pricing. Buyers are paying a significant premium for a legacy brand, an aging township, and a location that has become increasingly congested. Unless purchased at a substantial discount, Prestige Shantiniketan is difficult to recommend as a value-driven purchase and is likely to disappoint buyers seeking strong returns or modern luxury living.
